# Solana Health

> Solana Health is an allied health clinic at Shop 1, 448 Bunnerong Road, Matraville NSW 2036, in Sydney's south-eastern suburbs. It offers chiropractic care and dry needling now, with physiotherapy to follow. Open Monday to Saturday, 8am to 8pm. Phone 0433 363 460. Online bookings via Cliniko. HICAPS on-site claiming and Medicare Chronic Condition Management Plan (EPC) referrals accepted.

## Key facts
- Principal chiropractor: Dr Angelo Marketos (Chiropractor), practising since 2011, AHPRA registration CHI0001597312, member of Chiropractic Australia. Bachelor of Chiropractic Science and Master of Chiropractic.
- Services available now: chiropractic (spinal adjustments, mobilisation, soft tissue therapy, exercise advice) and dry needling.
- Services coming soon: physiotherapy. Recovery services (infrared sauna, red light therapy) are planned for a later stage.
- Conditions commonly seen: lower back pain, neck pain, headaches, sciatica, postural strain, shoulder injuries, sports injuries, knee and ankle sprains, WorkCover and CTP injuries.
- Areas served: Matraville, Maroubra, Malabar, Chifley, Little Bay, Phillip Bay, La Perouse, Eastgardens, Pagewood, Hillsdale, Botany and the wider Randwick and Bayside council areas.
- No referral needed for chiropractic. GP referral needed only to claim under a Medicare care plan.
- Parking on Bunnerong Road and side streets. Bus routes 390X, 391 and 393 stop nearby. Ground-floor, step-free entry.
- Operating entity: ANJM Pty Ltd trading as Solana Health.
